title: Second Brain Governance Event
description: One immutable record in ClaimStore/events/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. A claim's current status is derived by replaying its events in occurred_at order - see claimstore.current_status().

claim_id.description: The claim this event applies to, or null for connector-level events (e.g. connector-run).

actor.description: Who or what caused this event: a connector name, 'kep', or a human identifier (e.g. an owner value from second-brain.yml).

channel.description: Where a human decision was made, e.g. 'cli' or 'telegram'.

payload.description: Event-type-specific data, e.g. {"action": "propose", "reason": "..."} for a kep-decision.
